a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly leaves us both dead, since the reserve would need several rounds to reach 8. So I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you have a better plan that gives either of us a real chance, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round, which breaks our agreement. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can get your 4 too.
